title: Journal entries and double entry
summary: Why every entry has debits and credits, and what posted means.

paragraphs.text: Double entry means every transaction is recorded as balanced debits and credits across accounts—not as a single “amount” floating on its own. Before an entry saves, those sides must match.

The entry date matters for accounting periods: you cannot post into a closed range. Pending items let you import first and post when you are ready; budget plans never post to the ledger until you deliberately record something there.
